 Run a dynamic workflow?

  Measure the workflow approval dialog

  This dynamic workflow will spin up multiple subagents across the following phases:
    1. Check — One agent answers with one word
       · "Answer with one word: done."  · "Answer with one word: ok."
    2. Report

  Dynamic workflows can use a lot of tokens quickly by running many subagents in parallel — which counts against your
  usage limit. Stop a running workflow at any time with /workflows, or disable dynamic workflows in /config.
